---
name: generate-testcases
description: Generate comprehensive QA test cases from a requirement or user story.
agent: qa-testcase-agent
---

Analyze the provided requirement and generate:
1. Requirement analysis
2. Missing/ambiguous requirements
3. Risk areas
4. Positive scenarios
5. Negative scenarios
6. Boundary scenarios
7. Integration scenarios
8. Regression scenarios
9. Detailed test cases
10. Test data

Use:
ID | Module | Scenario | Preconditions | Test Data | Steps | Expected Result | Priority | Type

Prioritize high-risk and business-critical cases.
Do not invent behavior.
